listings.thesis: Packaging and test leverage for AI silicon; AI-adjacent, central-node.
listings.revisionNote: On a residual-alpha lens the strong May print (ATM +37.9% YoY) was instantly consumed by a +5.4% same-day repricing on top of a 120% YTD run; the name is now a consensus Strong Buy with valuation flags, so unpriced asymmetry shrank even as fundamentals confirmed.

priorCase.rankRationale: Residual-alpha-vs-passives lens: the capex hike to ~$8.5B, +10% LEAP target raise and >$250M CoWoS beat genuinely strengthen the advanced-packaging bottleneck (+2 fundamentals). But +156% YTD, +16% spike and consensus Strong-Buy status mean the news is largely consumed; unpriced asymmetry shrank, so hold rank.
